item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-b88783d4341450a0","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Lula assumed the presidency through the constitutionally recorded inauguration on 1 January 2023 after winning the November election; he and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin signed the official presidential inauguration record, which is maintained in the Senate archive and distributed to major constitutional institutions.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the source documents the formal start of Lula's term.","ruler_attribution":"The event directly concerns Lula's constitutional assumption of office and compliance with the formal succession process.","limitations":["This records formal accession and institutional continuity, not broader democratic performance during the year."]},{"source_id":"SRC-085b8e5bc60a9406","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"In 2023, Brazil improved international cooperation, risk assessment, and interinstitutional coordination in its anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing system, while the GAFI/GAFILAT assessment found that cooperation and coordination among authorities still needed strengthening and repression of money laundering remained insufficient for environmental crimes.","question_ids":["1B.6","1B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source reports institutional results for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns the Brazilian system operating under Lula's government, but does not attribute each outcome personally to Lula.","limitations":["The source does not identify specific presidential orders, budget choices, or individual appointments."]},{"source_id":"SRC-085b8e5bc60a9406","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The 2023 GAFI/GAFILAT assessment found strong supervision of most of Brazil's financial sector, but gaps in supervision of the non-financial sector.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The assessment covers Brazil's 2023 anti-money-laundering and proliferation-financing framework.","ruler_attribution":"This is an institutional finding about the system overseen by Lula's administration, without direct personal attribution.","limitations":["The source does not quantify staffing, funding, or presidential involvement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-085b8e5bc60a9406","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Brazil showed good performance in recovering corruption-related assets and improved measures against terrorist financing in 2023, but needed to intensify recovery of assets linked to other crimes and terrorism and improve the effectiveness of counter-terrorist-financing measures.","question_ids":["1B.6","1B.9","7B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source reports 2023 institutional performance.","ruler_attribution":"The results concern Brazilian public institutions during Lula's first year in office, not a documented personal action by Lula.","limitations":["The source provides no basis to infer Lula's personal conduct or intent."]},{"source_id":"SRC-085b8e5bc60a9406","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In 2023, Brazil had initiatives coordinating to detect misuse of companies, but faced challenges identifying beneficial owners; the assessment also found improved but still insufficient effectiveness in combating terrorist financing.","question_ids":["1B.6","7B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source reports findings for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns national enforcement institutions under Lula's administration, without direct evidence of his personal direction.","limitations":["No specific case, enforcement action, or presidential decision is identified."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b0c887dbe216cb99","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Supreme Federal Court's later accounting of the 8 January 2023 attacks reported 1,878 complaints, 177 investigations still underway, 144 case dismissals for lack of just cause, and 1,402 people held criminally responsible, including convictions and non-prosecution agreements.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.9","4B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The underlying violence occurred in January 2023, while the source is a later retrospective accounting of judicial proceedings.","ruler_attribution":"The fact documents STF-led judicial accountability for the anti-democratic attacks during Lula's term; it does not establish that Lula personally directed the proceedings.","limitations":["The source is dated 2026 and does not describe Lula's specific crisis instructions or the executive branch's operational decisions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b0c887dbe216cb99","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The STF reported that 431 defendants received prison sentences, 419 received substituted restrictive sanctions, and 552 entered non-prosecution agreements requiring confession and alternative sanctions; the reported penalties included fines and collective moral-damage compensation.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.9","4B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"These are later judicial outcomes arising from the January 2023 attacks.","ruler_attribution":"The sanctions were imposed by the judiciary, not shown as personally ordered by Lula.","limitations":["The source does not assess detention conditions, proportionality, or executive compliance beyond reporting the judicial outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d47df46d2e142fe2","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"A TCU audit conducted from January to September 2023 found major CadÚnico data inconsistencies: 40.3% of sampled families receiving Auxílio Brasil in December 2022 had income inconsistencies, 33.4% had different family composition from the records, and 14.8% had addresses that did not match the reported homes.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The audit was conducted during 2023 and examined records through June 2023, with some baseline data from December 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern the social-assistance administration inherited and supervised by Lula's government; the source attributes causes partly to MDS supervision and municipal execution failures.","limitations":["The audit covers a transition from Auxílio Brasil to Bolsa Família and does not isolate defects newly caused by Lula's administration."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d47df46d2e142fe2","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The TCU estimated that 22.5% of Bolsa Família beneficiary families did not meet program requirements, equivalent to 4.75 million families and an estimated R$34.18 billion impact in 2023; it attributed weaknesses to self-declaration without sufficient controls, inadequate supervision, weak municipal support, and insufficient household verification.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The estimate concerns 2023 beneficiaries and was based on audit work through May 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding implicates the MDS and subnational administration during Lula's government, but does not prove personal presidential responsibility.","limitations":["The estimate is an audit projection, not a determination that every identified case was fraudulent."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d47df46d2e142fe2","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The TCU ordered the MDS to reconcile CadÚnico discrepancies with government databases by the end of 2024 and recommended stronger controls over self-declared data, state and municipal supervision, household verification, periodic data evaluation, and local-agent training and support.","question_ids":["6B.5","6B.7","6B.9","8B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The order followed a 2023 audit and set a post-period deadline for corrective action.","ruler_attribution":"The required corrective action was directed to Lula's MDS, but the source does not show whether the administration completed it during 2023.","limitations":["Implementation after 2023 is outside the requested period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c2056508ee4622e2","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"A TCU operational audit of the 2023 Bolsa Família found that the R$600 family-level Complementary Benefit harmed per-capita equity by paying the same amount regardless of family size; new first-child and per-person citizenship benefits improved equity but did not offset that effect, leaving the design favorable to single-person families.","question_ids":["5B.8","6B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The audit evaluated the program during 2023 and covered 2022-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns the design implemented by Lula's administration, though the R$600 component was inherited from Auxílio Brasil.","limitations":["The source expressly notes that the adverse component was inherited, limiting direct attribution to Lula."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c2056508ee4622e2","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The TCU found the redesigned Bolsa Família more cost-effective than Auxílio Brasil overall, but estimated that excluding the Complementary Benefit could save 9.1% of the budget while preserving the same poverty impact, or reduce poverty by an additional 7.2% at the same budget.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.8","6B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The audit covers the program's 2023 design and implementation.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns a Lula-government redesign that improved cost-effectiveness relative to Auxílio Brasil while retaining an inefficient inherited component.","limitations":["These are model-based estimates rather than observed completed savings or poverty reductions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c2056508ee4622e2","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The TCU estimated that 2.2 million excess families were receiving Bolsa Família in August 2023 and found deficiencies in regional coverage indicators; it recommended redesigning the program and building more reliable coverage measures.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The estimate and audit findings directly concern August 2023 and the 2023 program.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns the program administered by Lula's MDS, while the audit also reflects inherited registration and design problems.","limitations":["The source reports estimated inclusion errors and does not establish intentional political targeting."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c2056508ee4622e2","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The TCU warned that Bolsa Família's redesigned eligibility bands and benefits, combined with their proximity to the minimum wage, could discourage formal employment and recommended that the MDS reassess these labor-market effects.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.8","5B.9","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The warning concerns the program design evaluated for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The concern applies to a policy implemented under Lula's administration, without proof that the predicted disincentive had already occurred.","limitations":["The source identifies a risk and recommendation rather than a measured realized employment effect."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9265021fa02ec592","start_unit":1,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The supplied IPEA document is a 2024 report page describing an ODS 10 publication on inequality, but the supplied units provide no Brazil-specific 2023 finding, policy result, or institutional assessment attributable to Lula.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Published in 2024 and not substantively tied to a documented 2023 Lula-period event in the supplied units.","ruler_attribution":"No direct ruler attribution is available from the supplied text.","limitations":["Only repository metadata and an abstract-level description are supplied; the linked PDF contents are not included."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-4abcae3f80d6a1dc","SRC-e692e02c3ae3a4a0","SRC-58aa827b89fc15c0","SRC-6d99aeb0e88aadec","SRC-ee46872159946f58"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied sources contain only landing-page metadata, report links, or navigation text rather than substantive 2023 findings.","The STF source is a later retrospective accounting of January 2023 events and should not be treated as a contemporaneous 2023 assessment.","Institutional findings are mapped to Lula's governing period with explicit limits where the source does not establish personal presidential direction or causation."]}
